label: organizations confirmed breached
detail: Previdian, SOCRadar, Wordfence and Hunt.io all report no successful remote-code execution; Sophos retracted its one claim.

label: exploit attempts seen by Cloudflare
detail: Tens of thousands within 45 minutes of disclosure, millions by Oct 22.

label: first malware riding on it
detail: Attackers are trying to enlist exploited servers into a Mirai variant called Potassium for DDoS floods. No infection count has been published.

label: UK government digital services confirmed unavailable
detail: Plus four partially unavailable, mostly precautionary. The NCSC has issued about 50,000 warnings.

label: PHP services Censys still assesses as vulnerable
detail: Across about 3.1 million hosts, as of Oct 23. Versions before 8.2 will never get an official fix.

label: on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
detail: No federal emergency directive either. A listing is CISA's formal verdict that exploitation is real.
